items.title: Glenn Zottola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 7, 2020
items.q: he’s a completely different character than Trump, completely. As far as humility.

ctx.x: Absolutely. Do you have any thoughts about where our country is at the moment and where it’s going?

It’s been, you know I don’t get into politics, but the last four years have been frightening for me. And I hope that the future will be better. I hope. I mean I wouldn’t want to be Joe Biden inheriting this but obviously he’s not a young man and he must have some kind of passion to do it. I saw him interviewed on “The Tonight Show,” this is before he decided to run, and they said are you going to run. And he said I don’t know if I’m emotionally ready for it. I mean he’s a completely different character than…

I’ve resisted — I guess I’m an optimist and you know in the last eight months or so people are saying things like it’s never going to be the same, it’s never going to be the same. And I’m stubbornly refusing to embrace that just yet.
